archive.reconstruct: Concatenate parts in order, verify SHA256, extract into a fresh directory.
archive.timing_scope: Compression and full byte readback; excludes scanning, splitting and Git publication.

reproduction: Exclusive-create stages have completed; do not replay paid calls. Exact dataset, splits, programs, native results, responses, reviews, rejected-source validation-only adapter, zero-API preflight and operator failure/recovery are retained. Offline audit scores saved predictions. New trials require new directories and cumulative budget coverage. Source checks are review aids, not sandboxes.
runtime_scope: Base commit/clean metadata copied from previous delivery. New source-reuse and regression changes were uncommitted when frozen; exact experimental bytes are recorded independently in plan.frozen_files.
scope: One A/B pair per model on public voice regression with unseen patients. B adds the complete measured leader source and optional exact edits. Full requested/resolved source, failures, diagnoses and actual final predictions retained. Seven final patients do not establish general or clinical validity. UCI source is CC BY4.0; attribution retained in source.json.
